Preview: Your next trip is closer than you think. Offer ends Sunday.
Body: Hey,

It's been a bit since we've seen you around. We get it — life stacks up, seasons shift, and sometimes the trail has to wait.

When you're ready to start planning again, we'd like to help. Take 20% off your next order at Northbay Supply through Sunday.

No pressure. Just a straightforward discount when the timing is right for you.
